_comment: Evaluation set of the combinations (SRCH-060…068; gate in contract/lm-quality.json `combinations`). `items`: Tatoeba clauses and windows (`src` clause / window) and HSK single words (`word` true) with their toneless pinyin syllables, split into `dev` (tuning) and `test` (gate); each is queried spaced (`wo men`) and unspaced (`women`). `neg`: English-like inputs that should not produce combinations. `stress`: numerals and measure words (`word` false = not a headword). Derived from pipeline/out/packs/sentences.db and the HSK list.
